newsitem.title: USA: Marvel seeks extension to file 10-Q.
newsitem.headline: Marvel seeks extension to file 10-Q.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said Thursday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an extension to file its 10-Q for the period ended June 30.

The company said it is seeking the extension for a variety of reasons, including its Chapter 11 filing, the resulting litigation, the proposed plan of reorganization and its associated agreement in principle on certain key economic terms. In addition, it cited its change in control of ownership and the continuing negotiations of a replacement DIP facility and other short term line of credit facilities.
Marvel said it is in the process of completing its quarterly report and expects to file it within the prescribed extension period.
